This is because addition 45.7% aluminum in TiAl-based alloy results in a lot of peritectic reaction occurs . Coarse grains of peritectic reaction has been formed in many(as shown in Table 2(3 #)) and it can effectively reduce tensile strength.
The void formed by the grain boundary sliding and atom diffusion, furthermore grew into crack so as to induce fracture. Stress rupture life increases with increasing grain size.

Niobium and tungsten are refractory metal elements and diffuse slowly that solute in α2 and γ lamellar structure can strengthen the microstructure so as to guarantee high-temperature strength and thermal stability.
